findings.detail: Issuer-name normalization retained instrument sequence suffixes on repeated AB Centers rows even though the source issuer cell has no numeric suffix.
Issuer-name normalization retained instrument sequence suffixes on repeated ADPD Holdings rows even though the source issuer cell has no numeric suffix.

rationale: This is a real issuer-name formatting extraction error. The bundle's holdings slice shows stored issuer_name values with trailing sequence numbers for repeated instruments, while the raw filing's Portfolio Company rows list the issuer names without those numeric suffixes; the suffixes belong to the pipeline's disambiguated investment identifier, not the issuer name.
